additional_info.subject: Re: ID0453570-DC/Si-D/BE-[Y2 / S6 313703531001] Charging issue CRM:03056000083 - Ticket 141471
additional_info.body:
Dear Mr. Vermeulen,
I am reaching out from the Technical Support team in regards of ticket
ID0453570
. The ticket was opened for charging interruptions at 300kW on charger
Y2/S6 313703531001
.
As no timestamp was provided, I went through the logs for the first 3 days of October, and could only find two events related to a charging interruption when delivering 300kW on 01.10.2025. Here is a summary from my logs analysis:
Charging session starts on DC1 at 2025-10-01T12:53:45.
DC1 delivers 300kW:
2025-10-01T12:54:45.281520+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [4021] [DCC]  |2025-10-01T12:53:52|DC1: |EVSE_MaxPwr[kW]=300|EVSE_MaxCur[A]=381|EVSE_NowPwr[kW]=297.2|EVSE_NowCur[A]=379|EVSE_NowVol[V]=784.1|EV_TarCur[A]=381|EV_TarVol[V]=799|EV_SOC[%]=61|EVSE_DESpwr[kW]=300|Pilot=4
At 2025-10-01T12:55:17 the session is suddenly interrupted, and we see the following two error messages:
We see a sudden drop of the pilot state from vehicle side during charging from C-->B (error 67). While the charger was performing the shutdown phase, we receive a pilot state C from the EV (error 35).
I checked the EVMAC of the vehicle, ec.94.68.00.0d.a3, and I believe this is a Daimler truck (eActross 600 possibly?).
Could you please confirm that?
I am stating this, as this is a known behavior from Daimler trucks, and Daimler is working on a solution on their side.
A new charging session with the same EV is started on DC2 at 2025-10-01T12:56:37.
DC2 delivers 300kW:
2025-10-01T13:11:08.422440+00:00 swcpu [user:debug] [4021] [DCC]  |2025-10-01T12:56:42|DC2: |EVSE_MaxPwr[kW]=300|EVSE_MaxCur[A]=378|EVSE_NowPwr[kW]=296.8|EVSE_NowCur[A]=376|EVSE_NowVol[V]=790.3|EV_TarCur[A]=379|EV_TarVol[V]=806|EV_SOC[%]=73|EVSE_DESpwr[kW]=300|Pilot=4
At 2025-10-01T13:11:23, the outlet experienced a prolonged event of "error polling coap". This is an internal communication interruption between PLC and SECC. As a result of this prolonged communication interruption, the charging is interrupted the session at 2025-10-01T13:11:54.
I checked the charger and now it is running on FW v8.0.5, but on 2025-10-01 it was running on FW v6.0.3. This error polling coap is a error which was affecting the SECC version up to v7.0.5, and it is solved now on v8.0.5, therefore there is no risk for it to happen again.
In conclusion:
In the events I analyzed, there is no sign of temperature issue on the outlets when charging at 300kW.
One session was interrupted due to EV wrong behavior.
One session was interrupted due to internal communication error, which is now solved with the FW currently running on the charger.
Could you please verify if these timestamps are the ones you required an analysis for? Otherwise, please provide us with timestamps (date and hour) of the events you need an analysis for.
Thank you in advance for your collaboration and feedback! Looking forward to hearing form you soon!
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
